what: The external synthesis (E1-E5) and its falsifiers, frozen before the repository's learning architecture was read in this cycle.
why: A prior that can be edited after the audit is not a prior. A falsifier written after the evidence is a description of the evidence.
ordering_rule: external synthesis -> freeze -> repo audit -> crosswalk -> falsification -> product decision
what_this_does_not_establish: That E1-E5 are correct. Only that they were fixed before the audit. A hash proves order, not truth.
